content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for AIIMS Jodhpur Project Technical Support-III Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Jodhpur (AIIMS Jodhpur) for filling up project-based technical roles.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post available in AIIMS Jodhpur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The available post for this recruitment drive is Project Technical Support-III under advertisement number AIIMS/JDH/MICRO/2026/1599.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available under this notification?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Project Technical Support-III post in this recruitment cycle.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application for AIIMS Jodhpur Project Technical Support-III?
faq.answer: The mode of application is Walk-in. Eligible candidates directly report to the interview venue on the specified date with required documents.

faq.question: Q5. When is the walk-in interview scheduled for?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled to take place on 07-10-2026. Candidates must ensure they arrive at the venue on time.

faq.question: Q6. What is the educational qualification required for Project Technical Support-III?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a three years graduate degree (BMLT) with three years of experience preferably in a government institution, or a PG degree (MSc MLT) / MSc Microbiology.

faq.question: Q7. What is the upper age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants applying for the Project Technical Support-III post is 35 years as per the official recruitment guidelines.

faq.question: Q8. What is the monthly salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 28,000 per month plus 20% HRA as applicable under the project terms.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee required to attend the interview?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for any category including General, OBC, SC, and ST candidates appearing for the walk-in interview.

faq.question: Q10. What documents should I carry to the walk-in interview venue?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring all original educational certificates, experience certificates, identity proof, self-attested photocopies, passport-size photographs, and the filled application form.
